## Software

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
### Languages
Python, C++, MATLAB — core languages for control, simulation, and data analysis.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Frameworks
ROS 2, Isaac Sim, PyTorch — robotics middleware, simulation, and learning pipelines.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### IDEs & Editors
VS Code, Neovim — primary development environments with remote and embedded workflows.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### DevOps
Docker, Git, GitHub Actions — containerised builds, version control, and CI/CD.
:::

:::

## Hardware

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
### Drones
Custom quadrotors and off-the-shelf platforms for autonomous flight experiments.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Sensors
LiDAR, depth cameras, IMUs — perception stacks for mapping and state estimation.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Compute
NVIDIA Jetson, workstation GPUs — onboard and offboard compute for real-time control.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Prototyping
3D printing, PCB design — rapid iteration on mechanical and electronic components.
:::

:::
